-- What duckdb answers for every ClickBench query over hits.parquet in this directory.
--
-- Written by scripts/clickbench-answers, which says there how it decides what to record.
-- Do not edit this by hand. A number in here that nothing produced is worse than no
-- number at all, because the test that reads it will go green on it.
--
-- Each query is a line naming it and saying how much of the answer is settled, then the
-- column names, then the column types as duckdb's shell spells them, then a line per row.
-- Cells are separated by tabs. A null is the word NULL, which is what both shells print.
